hero.title: Listening should <highlight>grow music culture</highlight>.
hero.description: RESON distributes subscription revenue based on listener engagement—support rate, completion rate, and repeat listening—rather than raw play counts. We aim to help listeners discover music through compatibility and give them an optional way to support artists they value.
hero.note: No credit card required · Sign up in about a minute

about.title: Designed to reward more than the top 1%.
about.paragraph1: Streaming revenue often concentrates around the most-played artists. RESON uses an engagement score based on listening time, support rate, and completion rate to create more opportunities for independent and emerging artists, regardless of name recognition.
about.paragraph2: The distribution formula is published so artists can verify their own score and revenue.

distribution.title: Distribute by engagement
distribution.desc: Revenue is distributed using engagement calculated from support rate, completion rate, and repeat listening—not play counts alone.

formula.title: Publish the formula
formula.desc: The distribution formula is always public, allowing artists to verify their own score.

discovery.desc: Music discovery is designed around listener compatibility rather than artist popularity.

ArtistReport.title: Monthly report
ArtistReport.empty: There is no distribution history yet. Tracks become eligible after they exceed 100 plays.
ArtistReport.playTimeFormula: SUM(listened seconds × plan weight × duration factor) / 3600
ArtistReport.playTimeNote: Plan weights: Support+ 1.3 / Standard 1.0 / Student 0.7 / Free 0.4 / AI-generated tracks are fixed at 0.1
ArtistReport.supportNote: Valid plays include only plays with a duration factor > 0 (at least 30 seconds listened)
ArtistReport.rawFormula: raw_score = listening-time score×0.4 + support rate×0.35 + completion rate×0.25
ArtistReport.distributionFormula: distribution = monthly pool × (this artist's raw_score / total raw_score across all artists)
ArtistReport.tipsRevenue: Tip revenue (calculated separately and paid directly outside the distribution pool): ¥{amount, number}
ArtistReport.tracksDescription: Only tracks with more than 100 cumulative plays are eligible for distribution (in_distribution = true).

transparency.title: How distribution works (transparency policy)
transparency.paragraph1: 75–80% of monthly subscription revenue goes into the artist distribution pool. An engagement score is calculated from listening time, support rate, and completion rate, then the pool is allocated proportionally. Distribution is based on <bold>engagement</bold>, not raw play counts, which helps independent artists compete.
transparency.paragraph2: The support rate includes hearts and tips, plus boost hearts 🚀 (3 free per month, then ¥30 each, capped at 23 per month) at <bold>double weight</bold>. Of each additional ¥30 boost charge, 70% (¥21) goes directly to the boosted artist without passing through the distribution pool.

PrivacyPage.title: Personal data handling
PrivacyPage.description: This page explains the information RESON handles and the settings and request options available to users.

data.title: Data categories and purposes
data.email: Email address and authentication data: account creation, login, identity verification, and communication.
data.listening: Listening and support records: playback services, distribution calculations, and fraud investigation. Only when enabled in settings, listening history is also used for recommendations and music-persona tag suggestions.
data.social: Profile, posts, comments, and messages: providing the social features you choose to use. Content you publish may be visible to other users.
data.payments: Purchases, payments, and artist payout details: payments, revenue distribution, accounting, and legally required records.
data.minors: Parent or guardian information for minor artists and student-verification data: application review and eligibility checks.
data.basis: We process data under the legal basis appropriate to each purpose, including contract performance, legal obligations, legitimate interests in preventing abuse, and consent for optional features. Optional use of listening history can be disabled at any time in settings.

services.title: Storage and external services
services.providers: The service is configured to use Supabase for authentication and data storage, Cloudflare R2 for tracks and other files, Stripe for payments, and Resend for notification emails. Service regions and contractual arrangements vary by operating environment.
services.transfer: Transfers outside the EU and safeguards: {value}
services.browser: The browser uses cookies required to keep you signed in and local storage for settings such as theme and volume. If we add non-essential device storage for advertising or analytics, we will obtain any required consent separately.

rights.title: Your choices and requests
rights.options: You can change visibility and optional use of listening history in <settings>Settings</settings>. After signing in, you can request access, correction, a portable copy, deletion, restriction, or objection through <requests>Personal data requests</requests>.
rights.response: We review the request, identity verification, and applicable retention obligations before responding. We aim to respond within one month of receipt, and explain the reason when a request cannot be fulfilled. You may also have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.
